text: Driveways and farms lose signal. Scout is built for that: you keep charting, nothing you type is lost, and no card is charged twice.
Here's Biscuit's SOAP. Now say the signal drops.
This brown banner comes up. Your changes are kept on the page, and they save when the signal is back.
It says Not saved yet. Your text is kept right here.
When the signal comes back, the banner goes away, and your text saves by itself.
Nothing to retype. Just stay on the page until it's saved.
Payments work differently. When it's time to pay, click Checkout.
and you click Card on file.
It says Not charged. If the card was charged after all, it will show here when the connection returns.
Wait for the signal, then look at the invoice.
If it's still open, like this one, try once more. If it says paid, you're done.
Two mistakes to avoid: closing the tab while you're offline, and running the card again and again. Stay on the page until it saves, and check the invoice before you charge again.
